meta.name: Rulers of Fortune
meta.description:
A young man aspires to rise through the ranks of Rio's gambling underworld — unaware of the dangerous game of betrayal, lust and blood that awaits him.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: Profeta
videos.overview: Profeta devises a risky scheme to increase his influence in the gambling world. A wedding party serves as the backdrop for secret deals and partnerships.

videos.title: All in
videos.overview: After a dangerous encounter with Búfalo, Profeta makes a bold promise. Meanwhile, Leila draws a French investor into a double-edged alliance.

videos.title: Hustlers and Fools
videos.overview: Profeta and Mirna scheme around Búfalo's slot machines, raising Suzana's suspicions. At a family barbecue, old tensions and unusual bonds surface.

videos.title: Pyramid
videos.overview: Politicians debate licensing the illegal lottery. Suzana plots against Profeta and Mirna, and a violent night threatens to unravel everything.

videos.title: The Nest and the Cage
videos.overview: As Profeta's fate hangs in the balance, secrets from Leila's past resurface. Meanwhile, Mirna goes to great lengths to justify her actions to the board.

videos.title: Turf War
videos.overview: Mirna and Profeta sign a deal. A samba school rehearsal erupts in violence, and someone close to Profeta's family learns the cost of betrayal.

videos.title: Treacherous Beast
videos.overview: Búfalo and Profeta are summoned by the board. A funeral descends into terror, while a carnival ball sets the stage for carnage.

videos.title: The Board
videos.overview: The board meets to decide Profeta's future. Xavier maneuvers Santiago into leading the samba school and long-buried secrets finally come to light.
